server_result.method: Use the already-running loopback HTTP server declared by the render plan and load every target through system Google Chrome.
server_result.evidence: The loopback origin returned the public Site and generated catalog for all 21 target routes; each target reached its named state with zero console warnings or errors.

captures.method: Local Google Chrome exact-viewport capture controlled through Playwright after the route reached its planned state.
captures.evidence: The requested screen and state were rendered at the exact planned viewport and recorded as a PNG. Reduced-motion targets used the browser media preference override.
